finalText:
**Drafted 4.2.0 in [CHANGELOG.md:20](CHANGELOG.md:20).** 380 commits, 12 matter.

Three breaking. Expired tokens now return `401`, not `403`. Internal error types stopped being re-exported from five modules. The v1 export route was deleted under a `refactor(api)` label.

One feature. Webhook retries with backoff.

Eight fixes worth naming. Two need your eye. The histogram unit fix will shift dashboards. Request bodies stopped being logged.

Left out on purpose: 10 `perf` commits and 16 dep bumps. Your template has no heading for either.

Next: check nothing public called the v1 export route. Then decide if `perf` earns a fourth heading.
